Since "this service" isn't pinned to one thing, here's the most concrete read — the current work status of the `rupng` repo:

**Branch:** `update-061826` (tracking `origin/update-061826`, in sync)

**Uncommitted work — a large in-progress refactor:**
- **`packages/events/` is being deleted** (entire package: `Events.ts`, `Access.ts`, payloads, configs) — its concerns appear to be moving into `packages/endpoint/` (`Access.ts`, `EventTypes.ts` modified) and a new untracked `packages/system/`.
- **Core services modified** across `apps/core`: `app` (`AppService`, `AppPublicService`, `AppJob`, `CloudManifest`), `auth` (`AuthService`), `web` (`PubSubService`, `WebsocketService`), and `webproxy` (`ProxyService`).
- **`packages/services/` reworked** — `Application`, `Consumer`, `Daemon`, `Job`, `Service`, and `aws/Kafka.ts` all touched, plus a new untracked `FastifyLog.ts`.
- **Cloud/CDK churn** — `cloud/src/app.ts` and `ServiceStack.ts` edited; lots of `cdk.out/` synth artifacts added/deleted (the `widget-*` stacks removed, `app-dev`/`app-local` added). These are generated and probably shouldn't be tracked.
- **New untracked work**: `apps/core/app/src/endpoints/`, `packages/api/src/app/`, `tools/`, plus some stray files (`claude-conversation.json`, `api-requests.json`).

So in short: a sizable mid-flight refactor centered on **replacing the `events` package with an `endpoint`/`system` model** and reworking the services + cloud stacks. Nothing committed yet.
